verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents is a framework rather than an agent, so whether it ships an official MCP server is a fair question. The evidence only shows client-side MCP support: agents built with the framework consume tools from external MCP servers via MCPToolset. That is a different capability and earns no credit here. No first-party LiveKit MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint that external agents can connect to is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
